district_name: North Country Union Junior High School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: "North Country Union Junior High School Board" -- the North Country Union Junior High School District, a union junior high district (16 V.S.A. section 748) in the North Country Supervisory Union (member towns: Derby, Holland, Jay, Morgan, Newport City, Westfield). Operates grades 7-8.
North Country SU NCUJHS board page (official).

board.org_name: North Country Union Junior High School Board

sources.note: North Country SU NCUJHS board page (official): rosters by school year 2020-21 through 2026-2027. The full boards field 10 members on the split Derby 3, Newport City 3, Holland 1, Jay 1, Morgan 1, Westfield 1; Westfield has fielded no director since 2022-23. Member set established from the rosters and member-town warnings (Holland's March 3, 2026 warning votes this district's budget) -- CORRECTING the earlier frame: Holland IS a member; Newport Town is NOT (it never appears on a roster and its warnings carry no NCUJHS article). The district's articles/apportionment schedule were not fetched (named missing document).

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, town-only electorates, 16 V.S.A. section 748 pattern). Holland and Jay each elect a single union director who sits on both this board and the NCUHS board. Westfield's seat is unfilled (no holder since 2022-23; its expiration is unpublished).
